battle.name: 智利獨立戰爭
battle.brief: 智利獨立戰爭始於1810年，歷經殖民體制崩解、王國時期內戰，最終以智利脫離西班牙王國告終。聖地亞哥及智利中部是政治與軍事衝突核心，參戰步兵使用火繩槍（Matchlock musket），其正式列裝年份為1520年。

kit.name: 火繩槍
kit.history: 火繩槍要點火、要瞄、要排隊。方陣把這些弱點變成了整齊的彈幕。

countries: 這場戰爭的地理主軸是智利中部由聖地牙哥至康塞普西翁的中央谷地，側翼包括波特雷、聖卡洛斯與奇洛埃等南部戰區，以及通往秘魯的太平洋航路。1810年的愛國派依省民兵、從秘魯返回的獨立軍分隊及後來的智利陸軍作戰；王室派則掌握西班牙籍正規軍、若干歐洲歸化營、忠於王室的智利軍隊和主要城堡。同一批智利籍士兵會因效忠對象不同而分列雙方。1811年，西班牙本土援軍在奧唐奈率領下抵達，協助王室派迅速恢復對中部城市的控制。秘魯獨立法提供早期武器與基地，拉普拉塔河聯省的門多薩則在1817年成為聖馬丁整軍越嶺的支點，但聯省並非對智利的主要交交國。英美商人曾出售或轉運軍火，也不是1818年決定戰役的正式聯軍。海岸船隻、河口渡口和中央谷地的道路，因而成為補給、撤退與攻擊方向的核心。
countriesEn: The geographic backbone of the war was the central valley of Chile from Santiago to Concepción, with southern theaters at Puerto, San Carlos, and Chiloé, and with Pacific routes leading to Peru. In 1810, the patriot side fielded provincial militias, detachments of independence armies returning from Peru, and later the Chilean Army; the royalist side held Spanish regular regiments, several European immigrant units, Chilean troops loyal to the Crown, and the principal fortresses. Soldiers of Chilean birth could appear on both sides according to the authority they served. In 1811, a metropolitan Spanish expedition under O'Donnell arrived and helped the royalists recover control of the central cities rapidly. Peru's independent government supplied early weapons and bases, while Mendoza in the United Provinces of the Río de la Plata served as the base for San Martín's reorganization before the crossing in 1817, although the United Provinces was not a principal belligerent in Chile. British and American merchants sold or transited weapons but were not formal allied contingents in the decisive campaigns of 1818. Coastal vessels, river crossings, and roads through the central valley therefore became central to movement, supply, retreat, and attack.
people: 一八一〇年的軍政樞紐集中在聖地牙哥第一執政委員會，成員包括米格爾·德拉·巴拉、路易斯·德拉·克魯斯、何塞·米格爾·卡雷拉與曼努埃爾·德·薩拉斯。卡雷拉先在克切雷瓜斯擊敗王室派，隨後因兵力分散和奧爾圖尼爾的戰役失利而失去主動權；貝納爾多·奧伊金斯則從秘魯戰場返國，發展出自己的軍政組織，並在埃爾羅布萊戰敗後仍保有重新編組的力量。王室派的重要將領包括安東尼奧·金蒂利亞亞、曼努埃爾·德·阿爾杜納特、何塞·奧爾多涅斯、曼努埃爾·維森特·貝納維德斯、拉法埃爾·馬羅托與馬特奧·德·托羅。聖馬丁於1817年接掌智利軍，以整編軍令、訓練和後勤取代此前分散的省級民兵；阿根廷出生的胡安·格雷戈里奧·拉斯·赫拉斯指揮安第斯軍前鋒。托馬斯·科克倫則替智利訓練海軍與沿海運輸力量。上述指揮官的更替，經常直接改變一支軍隊能否持續作戰。
peopleEn: The military-political center in 1810 was the First Junta in Santiago, whose members included Miguel de la Barra, Luis de la Cruz, José Miguel Carrera, and Manuel de Salas. Carrera first defeated the royalists at Quechereguas, then lost initiative after dispersing his forces and suffering defeat through the campaigns led by Aldunate and Quintanilla. Bernardo O'Higgins returned from the Peruvian theater, built a separate military organization, and retained enough troops to reorganize after his defeat at El Roble. Important royalist commanders included Antonio Quintanilla, Manuel de Aldunate, José Ordóñez, Manuel Vicente Benavides, Rafael Maroto, and Mateo de Toro. San Martín took command of the Chilean forces in 1817 and replaced fragmented provincial mobilization with a unified command system, regular training, and disciplined logistics. Juan Gregorio de Las Heras, an Argentine officer, commanded the vanguard of the Army of the Andes. Thomas Cochrane trained the Chilean navy and its coastal transport force. Changes among these commanders often determined directly whether an army could remain operational.
kits: 一八一〇年前已列裝且可在交戰雙方確認的西班牙步兵標準槍械，是二〇二型步兵燧槍，採約十四點九毫米口徑滑膛，配置刺刀，部分單位另有短軍刀。西班牙步兵使用二〇二式制服系統和黑色毛氅barretina軍帽；槍兵把紙包槍彈放在腰後彈藥盒，並以背囊攜帶備用火藥與必需品。馬兵使用彎刀，炮兵則操作四磅、六磅或八磅青銅滑膛野戰炮，彈種包括球彈、葡萄彈與罐式群彈，使用黑火藥藥包。這些裝備在1810年後也由智利軍透過戰利品、採購及外地援助取得，因此不同部隊的槍械口徑、炮重和彈藥存量並不完全一致。聖馬丁的安第斯軍於1817年集結約三千二百名官兵、十六門野戰砲及逾一萬頭騾馬和馱畜，越嶺時還須負載炮車、備用火藥、炮彈、繩索、工具與鞋料。智利海岸的縱帆船及小型雙桅船負責輸送馬匹、武器和郵件；一旦風向、封鎖或陸路供應中斷，遠征軍便會缺乏彈藥與牲畜替換。
kitsEn: The standard Spanish infantry weapon already fielded before 1810 and verifiable on both sides was the Modelo 1802 infantry flintlock musket. It had a smoothbore of approximately 14.9 millimeters, carried a bayonet, and was accompanied by a short sword in some units. Spanish infantry used the 1802 uniform system and the black felt barretina cap. Musketeers carried paper cartridges in rear-mounted cartridge boxes, with reserve powder and necessities in their haversacks. Cavalry used sabers, while artillery crews operated four-, six-, or eight-pound bronze smoothbore field guns firing black-powder charges with ball, grapeshot, and canister. After 1810, Chilean forces obtained many of these same weapons through captures, purchases, and external assistance, so calibers, gun weights, and ammunition stocks differed between units. In 1817, San Martín's Army of the Andes assembled roughly 3,200 men, sixteen field guns, and more than 10,000 mules and pack animals. Gun carriages, reserve powder, shot, rope, tools, and shoe material also had to be carried over the mountains. Chilean coastal schooners and brigs transported horses, weapons, and dispatches; unfavorable winds, blockade, or an interrupted land route immediately reduced ammunition and animal supplies.
tactics: 1810年的普埃爾科奧戰鬥中，愛國派民兵以步兵縱隊和固定炮位封鎖通往聖地牙哥的南北道路，王室派則集中正規步兵，讓前排以齊射和刺刀頂住壓力。1811年卡雷拉在坎查拉亞達戰敗，顯示 provincial militia 在指揮分裂和補給不足時難以承受持續作戰。1813年奧伊金斯在埃爾羅布萊遭王室軍集中兵力打散分遣縱隊，隨後改採南撤整補、選擇有利隘口及逐步壓縮敵方據點的方法，並於1814年再取坎查拉亞達，包圍巴爾迪維亞，迫使守軍投降。1815年的第二次坎查拉亞達與奧克森慘敗，使後來的整軍特別重視集中使用火炮、夜間行軍、分批通過山口和維持道路。1817年聖馬丁先以「名稱征用」取得馬匹、牛隻和軍械，再由拉斯·赫拉斯的前鋒在查凱突然攻擊未及鞏固的王室軍。五月浦戰役中，智利軍以步兵火力、騎兵追擊和側向運動迫使拉法埃爾·馬羅托撤退。1818年五月浦決戰則採兩路夾擊：奧伊金斯部依 Cancha Rayada 山地通道威脅王室軍側翼，聖馬丁主力在九月五日清晨攻擊其正面與側翼；王室軍退向邁普河陡岸後，火炮、彈藥和指揮中斷使整個野戰縱隊崩解。
tacticsEn: At the Battle of Power Coo in 1810, patriot militia used infantry columns and fixed batteries to close the roads into Santiago, while the royalists concentrated regular infantry to withstand pressure with massed musket fire and bayonets. Carrera's defeat at Cancha Rayada in 1811 showed that provincial militia could not remain effective when command fragmented and supplies failed. At El Roble in 1813, O'Higgins was defeated when royalist forces concentrated against separated patriot columns. He subsequently withdrew south, reorganized, selected favorable approaches, compressed the royalist positions, won another victory at Cancha Rayada in 1814, and encircled Valdivia until its garrison surrendered. The Second Battle of Cancha Rayada and the disaster at Ochsen in 1815 led San Martín's later reforms to emphasize concentrated artillery, night marches, passage of columns through mountain defiles, and secure road communications. In 1817, San Martín seized horses, cattle, and military supplies during the Rodeo del Nombre. Las Heras's vanguard then surprised an incompletely entrenched royalist force at Chacay. At Maipú, Chilean infantry fire, cavalry pursuit, and lateral movement forced Rafael Maroto backward. At the decisive Maipú campaign of 1818, O'Higgins threatened the royalist flank through the Cancha Rayada heights while San Martín struck the front and side at dawn on September 5. The royalist retreat toward the steep banks of the Maipo River was followed by the loss of guns, ammunition, and command cohesion.
data: 一八一〇年九月十八日，聖地牙哥公開市政會議成立第一執政委員會；十一月四日，普埃爾科奧戰役擊退安東尼奧·金蒂利亞亞率領的王室軍。一八一一年三月十五日至十六日，卡雷拉在克切雷瓜斯獲勝；十月十九日，卡雷拉在坎查拉亞達敗於曼努埃爾·德·阿爾杜納特，十月二十二日又在邁普河附近被俘，第一階段由是崩潰。貝納爾多·奧伊金斯於1813年重返智利並一度收復聖地牙哥，但十一月十七日在埃爾羅布萊敗於何塞·奧爾多涅斯；1814年三月十六日，奧伊金斯在第二次坎查拉亞達取勝，並於八月二十八日至十月二十四日圍攻巴爾迪維亞，迫使王室守軍投降。1815年八月二十六日的第二次坎查拉亞達戰役，以及九月十六日至十七日的奧克森戰役，再次擊潰智利出擊部隊。1817年一月二十九日至二月十四日，聖馬丁率安第斯軍經烏斯帕雅塔與舊皇家道路越過安第斯山；四月進行「名稱征用」後補充牲畜和物資，五月十二日在查凱取勝，九月五日再於五月浦擊敗王室軍，十月十八日迫使巴爾迪維亞守軍投降。1818年一月一日，智利軍在聖羅伯托得手；二月十二日召開代表會議並正式宣告獨立；三月十九日於 Cancha Rayada 擊退馬特奧·德·托羅的反擊，三月二十六日占領塔爾卡瓦諾；九月五日的五月浦戰役則摧毀拉法埃爾·馬羅托的主要野戰軍。1818年通常被視為智利獨立戰爭的決定性終點，但王室派在奇洛埃的殘餘軍政據點延續至1826年一月，智利遠征軍在 Yungay 取勝後完成占領。各戰役傷亡數字因雙方戰報互有誇大而不能視為一致，本紀錄不填入未經核對的精確傷亡。
dataEn: On September 18, 1810, an open cabildo in Santiago formed the First Junta. On November 4, the Battle of Power Coo defeated Antonio Quintanilla's royalist force. On March 15–16, 1811, Carrera won at Quechereguas, but he was defeated by Manuel de Aldunate at Cancha Rayada on October 19 and captured near the Maipo River on October 22, ending the first phase. Bernardo O'Higgins returned to Chile in 1813 and briefly recovered Santiago, but José Ordóñez defeated him at El Roble on November 17. O'Higgins won the next Battle of Cancha Rayada on March 16, 1814, and his siege of Valdivia from August 28 to October 24 forced the royalist garrison to surrender. The Second Battle of Cancha Rayada on August 26, 1815, and the Battle of Ochsen on September 16–17 again destroyed patriot expeditionary forces. Between January 29 and February 14, 1817, San Martín's Army of the Andes crossed the mountains through Uspallata and the old royal road. The Rodeo del Nombre supplied animals and materiel in April; the army won at Chacay on May 12, defeated royalists at Maipú on September 5, and compelled the garrison of Valdivia to surrender on October 18. Chilean troops achieved a success at San Roberto on January 1, 1818. A representative assembly formally declared independence on February 12. The royalist counterattack at Cancha Rayada failed on March 19, Talcahuano fell on March 26, and the Battle of Maipú on September 5 destroyed Rafael Maroto's principal field army. The year 1818 is conventionally treated as the decisive end of the Chilean War of Independence, although royalist resistance at Chiloé continued until January 1826, when a Chilean expedition won at Yungay and completed the occupation. Contemporary casualty figures were inflated differently on both sides and cannot be treated as consistent; no unverified exact total is supplied here.
cause: 戰爭源於1808年拿破崙介入伊比利半島後，西班牙王權及其美洲代表的合法性出現裂縫。智利的殖民議政與軍事集團承認西班牙新樞紐、地方執政或自行治理的不同主張，權力因而分裂。1810年公開市政會議成立第一執政委員會後，舊王室官員與正規軍仍掌握武力、城防和若干省區，雙方遂以軍事行動爭奪中央政權。卡雷拉與奧伊金斯的競爭又加入省級民兵、秘魯獨立軍及地方軍隊之間的指揮矛盾，使一場政權衝突迅速變成內戰。西班牙本土援軍、秘魯王室軍及拉普拉塔河聯省的支持，使智利戰事從一開始就與南美洲其他殖民戰區相連。沒有一份計畫規定八年戰爭的完整進程；各方每奪得一處路口、城市或軍械庫，都會改變下一階段的兵力部署。
causeEn: The war arose from the crisis in Spanish royal authority and the legitimacy of its American representatives after Napoleon entered the Iberian Peninsula in 1808. Chilean political and military organizations recognized different claims involving the new Spanish juntas, local government, or self-government, leaving authority divided. After the open cabildo created the First Junta in 1810, former royal officials and regular troops still controlled armed force, city defenses, and several provinces, and both sides turned to military action to contest the central government. Rivalry between Carrera and O'Higgins added conflicts of command among provincial militias, forces returning from Peru, and regional troops, rapidly turning a constitutional struggle into civil war. Reinforcements from metropolitan Spain, royalist armies in Peru, and support from the United Provinces of the Río de la Plata connected the Chilean conflict with other South American theaters from the beginning. No plan established a predetermined eight-year course; each capture of a road junction, city, or arsenal immediately changed the deployment and supply calculations of the next phase.
impact: 制度上，1810年的民兵勝利沒有形成穩定中央軍隊，地方指揮分裂仍使王室派在1811年恢復控制。奧伊金斯在1813至1814年的反攻，以及1815年兩次敗仗，迫使後來的軍隊擱置臨時徵召，改為建立固定指揮、統一火力和可計算的供應系統。聖馬丁把道路保護、鞋料、馬匹、火藥、海運與前哨連成一體，使安第斯軍能在沒有持續奪取敵方城市的情況下深入奇洛埃與邁普地區。1817年攻下巴爾迪維亞切斷王室軍南部聯絡；1818年五月浦則使智利軍取得中央谷地的戰術主動權，並能向奇洛埃與康塞普西翁方向持續派遣遠征軍。智利也在此過程中形成常備陸軍與海軍的核心指揮結構，使1818年2月的獨立宣告獲得持續軍事行動支撐，但王室authority並未立即從南部所有據點消失。
impactEn: Institutionally, the militia victory of 1810 did not produce a stable central army, and local rivalries allowed the royalists to recover control in 1811. O'Higgins's counteroffensive of 1813–1814 and the defeats of 1815 forced later commanders to replace improvised recruitment with permanent command, coordinated artillery, and calculable supply systems. San Martín connected road security, shoes, animals, powder, coastal shipping, and advance posts so that the Army of the Andes could penetrate toward Chiloé and Maipú without continuously seizing enemy cities. The capture of Valdivia in 1817 severed the royalists' southern communications, while the Battle of Maipú in 1818 gave the Chilean army tactical initiative in the central valley and allowed it to sustain expeditions toward Chiloé and Concepción. Chile also formed the core command structure of its permanent army and navy during this process, giving the independence declaration of February 1818 practical military support, although royalist authority did not immediately disappear from every southern position.
result: 一八一八年五月浦的結果，是馬羅托的王室野戰軍失去大部分火炮、彈藥與指揮連續性，士兵向北撤往奇利安與南部邊境，中央谷地不再受到成建制王室軍威脅。智利代表會議早在二月十二日便宣告獨立，因此五月浦不是單一的建國儀式，而是讓政治宣告轉化為可防守領土的軍事決定。傳統史期通常在1818年五月浦結束，但若以西班牙軍最後撤離為標準，王室派仍在奇洛埃維持軍政統治；1826年一月的遠征與 Yungay 戰役後，該島最後的主要守軍投降。雙方對戰俘、失槍與陣亡數字的報告並不一致，因此無法可靠填入單一精確傷亡總數。最終軍事結果是智利保住中央政權、建立可持續越區作軍的常備力量，並迫使西班牙當局放棄智利殘餘據點。
resultEn: The result of the Battle of Maipú in 1818 was the loss of most of Maroto's field guns, ammunition, and command cohesion. Royalist troops withdrew north toward Chillán and the southern frontier, and the central valley was no longer threatened by a coherent royalist field army. Chile's representative assembly had already declared independence on February 12, so Maipú did not create the state by itself; it converted the political declaration into a military decision capable of holding territory. Conventional histories end the war in 1818, but if withdrawal of Spanish forces is the criterion, royalist government and troops remained at Chiloé. Following the expedition and victory at Yungay in January 1826, the island's last major royalist garrison surrendered. Contemporary accounts disagreed over prisoners, captured weapons, and deaths, so no single exact casualty total can be treated as reliable. The final military outcome was that Chile retained the central government, created a permanent force capable of operating beyond the capital, and compelled Spanish authorities to abandon their remaining positions in Chile.
